parameters.name: filter[phone_number]
parameters.description: Substring match against the stored country code + number.

parameters.name: filter[location]
parameters.description: Only tenants homed at this location, addressed by its KISS `location_id` (ULID).

parameters.name: filter[external_location_code]
parameters.description: Only tenants at the location with this code in your own system. Company-token callers only.

parameters.name: filter[external_tenant_id]
parameters.description: Look up specific tenants by the id they carry in your own system. Company-token callers only.

parameters.name: filter[type]
parameters.description: Narrow to `primary`, `secondary-tenant`, or `unit-accessor`. Same vocabulary as the `type` field on each row.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to return. Paging details come back in `meta.pagination`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 15, capped at 100.
